newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya names new military chief.
newsitem.headline: Kenya names new military chief.

text.p: Kenya's President Daniel arap Moi has appointed General Daudi Tonje the new military chief of general staff, replacing General Mahmoud Mohammed.
A statement from State House said on Wednesday that Tonje's appointment would be effective on November 1.
Tonje was trained at Sandhurst in England in the early 1960s where his contemporaries included former Nigerian presidents Olusegun Obasanjo and Ibrahim Babangida.
Tonje, Kenya's fourth military chief since independence from Britain in 1963, has served in the army for 35 years.

He is a member of Moi's Tugen clan of the Kalenjin tribe in the Rift Valley. The Daily Nation newspaper reported that Tonje had risen through the ranks from an officer cadet and had earned a reputation as a firm, fair and competent soldier.
